# mtncloud_wiki_page

Provides an MTN Cloud wiki page resource: a page in the tenant's wiki.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_wiki_page" "tfexample_wiki_page" {
  name     = "tfexample_wiki_page"
  category = "mtncloud-terraform"
  content  = file("${path.module}/terraform-wiki.md")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the wiki page

### Optional

- `category` (String) The category of the wiki page
- `content` (String) The content of the wiki page

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the wiki page

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_wiki_page.tf_example_wiki_page 1
```
